main_text.p: Discant hinc fide doctores, quanta solicitudine grex Domini sit obseruandus: quanta fidelitate pascendus, & quanta constantia, contra lupos & Satanæ molimina, protegendus.

Scopus & summa Epistolæ. Hortatur Ephesios vt in doctrina cælesti à se tradita, & in vita Christiana constanter permaneant, nec patiantur se ab eo abduci vlla ratione; non vinculis suis moti, non à falsis doctoribus persuasi ac decepti; quin potius quotidie in doctrina & pietate proficiant. Ita primùm fidem, deinde vitam Christianam informat. Scopus hic liquet ex v. 13. cap. 3.
main_text.head: PARTES
main_text.p: Epistolæ, præter vsitatam salutationem, in qua Ephesiis fauorem Dei & conscientiæ pacem & tranquillitatem precatur, (cap.1. v.1. 2.) & conclusionem; (cap.6. v. 21) duæ sunt. 1 Didascalica. i. institutio fidei: 11 Paranetica. i. vita Christiana informatio.
main_text.head: I. PARS.
main_text.p: PRIMÆ partis propositio hæc est: Vos Ephesij non tantum debetis constanter perseuerare in doctrina, fide & vita Christiana, sed etiam in ea proficere. Est ea manifesta ex peroratione prioris partis, v. 13 cap. 3. inchoatâ.
Paulus salutatis primum Ephesiis, incipit deinde concionari de benedictionibus Dei spiritualibus in Christo, quas propositâ primùm ge-nerali

page.notes: The right-hand strip shows the edge of the neighbouring page with fragments of its margin notes; these are not legible enough to transcribe and are left out. The first line of the page is a continuation from the previous page. The part numbers "1" and "11" in the paragraph on the Epistle's divisions are printed as such and are copied as printed, probably intended as I and II. The final word "ge-nerali" is split across the line end with the printed hyphen; the word continues on the next page.
